description: Database schema migration + SQLAlchemy model additions: add org_id FK column to AuditRecord, AuctionRecord, BidRecord, EscrowPORecord, and Form1Record; create memberships, legal_entities, and invite_tokens tables; add org_type enum column to organizations. All in a single Alembic migration chained after bb863566fc2f. Also remove Base.metadata.create_all() from api/src/main.py and replace it with a startup log-only message.
steps:
Step 1 — Add OrgType enum and new ORM models to packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py. Add at top: `import enum` and `class OrgType(str, enum.Enum): BRAND_OWNER = 'brand_owner'; RECYCLER = 'recycler'; PRO = 'pro'; PLATFORM = 'platform'`. Add `org_type: Mapped[OrgType | None] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=True)` column to Organization class (after `gstin` column). Add `legal_entities: Mapped[list['LegalEntity']] = relationship(back_populates='organization', cascade='all, delete-orphan')` to Organization.relationships. Add `memberships: Mapped[list['Membership']] = relationship(back_populates='organization', cascade='all, delete-orphan')` to Organization.relationships. Then append three new ORM classes at the bottom of the file:

  class LegalEntity(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'legal_entities'
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True, default=lambda: f'LE-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}')
    org_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), ForeignKey('organizations.org_id'), nullable=False)
    gstin: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(15), nullable=True)
    legal_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=False)
    state_code: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(2), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())
    organization: Mapped[Organization] = relationship(back_populates='legal_entities')

  class Membership(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'memberships'
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True, default=lambda: f'MEM-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}')
    user_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), ForeignKey('users.user_id'), nullable=False)
    org_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), ForeignKey('organizations.org_id'), nullable=False)
    role: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), default='viewer')
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())
    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint('user_id', 'org_id', name='uq_membership_user_org'),)
    organization: Mapped[Organization] = relationship(back_populates='memberships')
    user: Mapped['User'] = relationship()
  (add UniqueConstraint to sqlalchemy imports)

  class InviteToken(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'invite_tokens'
    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True, default=lambda: f'INV-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}')
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(256), nullable=False)
    org_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), ForeignKey('organizations.org_id'), nullable=False)
    role: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), default='viewer')
    token: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), unique=True, nullable=False)
    expires_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False)
    used_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    created_by: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), ForeignKey('users.user_id'), nullable=False)
    purpose: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), default='invite')
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())

Step 2 — Add org_id FK column to five business tables in organization.py. In AuditRecord class add: `org_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), ForeignKey('organizations.org_id'), nullable=True, index=True)` (nullable=True so existing rows survive migration backfill). Same pattern for AuctionRecord, BidRecord, EscrowPORecord, and Form1Record. These five classes already exist in the same file. Add `index=True` on each.
Step 3 — Update packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/__init__.py: add imports for `LegalEntity, Membership, InviteToken, OrgType` from `.organization` and add them to `__all__`.

Step 4 — Write the Alembic migration file packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/<new_rev>_phase1_tenancy_schema.py. Use revision id e.g. `a1b2c3d4e5f6`, down_revision = 'bb863566fc2f'. The upgrade() function must:
  a) op.add_column('organizations', sa.Column('org_type', sa.String(32), nullable=True))
  b) op.add_column('audit_records', sa.Column('org_id', sa.String(64), sa.ForeignKey('organizations.org_id'), nullable=True))
     op.create_index('ix_audit_records_org_id', 'audit_records', ['org_id'])
  c) Same pattern for tables: auctions (col=org_id), bids (col=org_id), escrow_pos (col=org_id), form1_records (col=org_id) — each gets ADD COLUMN nullable + CREATE INDEX.
  d) op.create_table('legal_entities', ...) with all columns from Step 1.
  e) op.create_table('memberships', ...) with all columns from Step 1 + UniqueConstraint.
  f) op.create_table('invite_tokens', ...) with all columns from Step 1.
  g) Non-destructive backfill: use op.execute() with raw SQL to set org_id on existing rows by joining to the first active organization: `UPDATE audit_records SET org_id = (SELECT org_id FROM organizations LIMIT 1) WHERE org_id IS NULL` — same for auctions, bids, escrow_pos, form1_records.
  h) After backfill, optionally leave nullable=True (do NOT alter to NOT NULL in this migration — that is a breaking change for zero-downtime). The NOT NULL enforcement is a future migration once all rows have values.
  downgrade() must DROP the new tables and columns in reverse order.

Step 5 — In api/src/main.py, remove the `await init_db()` call and the surrounding try/except that calls it. Replace with: `logger.info('[DB] Using Alembic for schema management — run: alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head')`. Keep the force-import of models block so they register with Base.metadata. Remove the `from synthetiq_shared.database import init_db` import too.
Step 6 — Verify ruff passes and the new models import cleanly: `uv run python -c 'from synthetiq_shared.models import Membership, InviteToken, LegalEntity, OrgType; print("FEAT-001 models OK")'`
acceptance_criteria: uv run python -c 'from synthetiq_shared.models import Membership, InviteToken, LegalEntity, OrgType; print("OK")' prints OK without error
uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head applies both migrations cleanly on a fresh SQLite DB
Alembic downgrade head-1 reverses the phase1 migration without error
AuditRecord, AuctionRecord, BidRecord, EscrowPORecord, Form1Record all have an org_id column in the ORM
api/src/main.py no longer calls init_db() or Base.metadata.create_all()
uv run ruff check api/src packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared passes
verification: uv run python -c 'from synthetiq_shared.models import Membership, InviteToken, LegalEntity, OrgType; print("FEAT-001 models OK")'
Remove synthetiq.db if present, then: uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
